narrative:
Inventory optimization analysis for material PL2__MD886B0A reveals a high-variability demand pattern 
with moderate lead time stability. The optimized policy increases safety stock from 156 to 634 
units to achieve the target 95% service level, while the order quantity is capacity-constrained 
to 2029 units. The recommended safety lead time of 2.0 days is lower than the current 
SAP setting of 4.5 days, suggesting an opportunity to reduce lead time buffers. 
Total annual cost increases by 652.50 USD (20.68%) primarily due to higher holding costs 
from increased safety stock required for the desired service level.
warnings: Optimized policy increases total annual cost by $652.50 (20.68%)
Recommended safety stock (634) is more than 3x current SAP value (156)
Capacity constraint limits order quantity to 2029, significantly below EOQ of 3026
